notes: CRITICAL — COLLAPSIBLE XCONTAINERS: When a user asks for a collapsible container (aus- und einklappbar) and it is an XContainer (div), use data-cb-func=html.panel with data-cb-generateheader="true" and data-cb-autoheadertitle for the title (from the prompt or auto-generated). For XFieldSet (fieldset), use the CSS class CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard instead — the legend provides the title. By default the panel starts unfolded; only add data-cb-folded=true if the user explicitly wants the panel to start collapsed.

classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a collapsible panel with shaded header that changes color when unfolded. Use on XFieldSet only (containers must use data-cb-func=html.panel with data-cb-autoheadertitle). Apply to EVERY XFieldSet that shall be a collapsible panel — a standalone panel AND every accordion member; NEVER to the accordion's wrapping container.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Flat: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a flat (no shading) collapsible panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Minimal: Apply to a fieldset to wrap it in a minimal collapsible panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_Index: Apply to a fieldset to add an index/anchor navigation panel. Use on XFieldSet only.
classes.CodBi_HTML_Panel_NoCordion: Apply to a container inside an accordion group to exclude it from accordion behavior.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_A: Apply to a container to set up accordion group A. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class (CodBi_HTML_Panel_Standard/Flat/Index/Minimal). Every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry a panel type class to become collapsible. Panels with the same accordion letter will fold/unfold together.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_B: Apply to a container to set up accordion group B. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_C: Apply to a container to set up accordion group C. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
classes.CodBi_Accordion_D: Apply to a container to set up accordion group D. The container is NOT a panel — do NOT give it a panel type class; every member XFieldSet inside must ALSO carry one.
